name: CIA EN.GER.ADR PFD NV 1
summary: CIA EN.GER.ADR PFD NV 1 represents the American Depositary Receipt (ADR) for Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais (CEMIG). CEMIG is a Brazilian power company that generates, transmits, and distributes electricity. The company is based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
